title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum Arena on 1993-01-26
lineage: Tascam DA-30 -[S/PDIF]-> (48k) Diamond xTreme SC > Cool Edit Pro > CDWave > FLAC (L8)
source: AKG 460/CK8's (2' spacing on custom T-Bar) > Marantz PMD-700 > (clone) DA-P20

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape with superb separation that captures a relaxed, warm‑summer night performance.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this audience recording for its near‑perfect instrument separation and full outdoor ambience, saying it “shines” compared to other AUD tapes from the run.  While they note a desire to matrix it with an SBD source, the existing tape is clear and lively, reflecting a laid‑back set that lets the songs breathe.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed 4‑star review; it is strongly positive about both sound quality and the relaxed vibe of the show, but limited data prevents higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great instrument separation, full outdoor openness, clear without needle‑paper hiss; no significant flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed, breathing set that lets the music breathe on a warm summer night, creating an easygoing atmosphere.
